title: Production serving: no Vite dev server, DATA_DIR outside repo, NODE_ENV=production, launchd
description: Why: pnpm dev serves the repo via Vite /@fs (verified 200 for pnpm-lock.yaml over https://rakazo.czaku.com); NODE_ENV=development disables auth rate limiting and secrets-guard. Do: (1) pnpm build for web; Caddy (~/dev/rakazo-setup/caddy/Caddyfile) serves apps/web/dist statically and proxies /api /rpc /novnc /events to 127.0.0.1:3100 — keep the authenticated screen proxy routes working; (2) .env NODE_ENV=production, DATA_DIR=/Users/luke/Library/Application Support/rakazo/data (migrate existing ./data), Better Auth secure cookies on the https origin; (3) launchd agents com.rakazo.api + com.rakazo.worker (KeepAlive, logs in ~/dev/rakazo-setup/.logs) replacing nohup pnpm dev; update start-rakazo.sh + INSTALL-LOG.md. AC (runtime): curl https://rakazo.czaku.com/@fs/… → 404; /health ok; login works from MacBook and iPhone app; a bot run completes; launchctl list shows both agents running; reboot-safe documented.

context.text: Killed old pnpm-dev stack by exact pid; running api/worker/sandbox-supervisor/web via start/preview scripts on live .env (health+root 200). No code change needed — /@fs 404 and /health proxy are Caddy fixes, launchd/Caddyfile/.env cutover documented in APPLY.md + ops/ for Luke to apply. commit bc8bbe3

Orchestrator correction 2026-09-10: the API has no /events HTTP route (thread events stream through /api and /rpc), so '/events' is NOT a required proxy path — gate must not require it. The noVNC screen byte-proxy lives in apps/web/vite.config.ts (attachNovncProxy, dev AND preview servers), not in the API: production keeps ONE 'vite preview' process bound to 127.0.0.1:5173 solely for /novnc/*; Caddy serves apps/web/dist statically for everything else and proxies /api/*, /rpc/*, /health to 127.0.0.1:3100. The ops/Caddyfile.rakazo-block is a site block to paste INTO ~/dev/rakazo-setup/caddy/Caddyfile, whose global options already set https_port 31415 (tailscaled forwards :443 → 127.0.0.1:31415) — it must not be adapted standalone.

Applied live 2026-09-10 ~10:25: .env NODE_ENV=production, DATA_DIR=/Users/luke/Library/Application Support/rakazo/data (migrated), BETTER_AUTH_URL/API_URL=https://rakazo.czaku.com; Caddy block swapped (static dist + /api /rpc /health → 3100, /novnc → preview 127.0.0.1:5173); launchd com.rakazo.{api,worker,sandbox-supervisor,web} running; verified /@fs → 404, /health 200 ok, root 200 (Studio + MacBook), /api/auth/get-session 200, preview bound 127.0.0.1:5173. Phone login + live bot run: pending Luke.
